round_history.main_rationale: Round 1 shipped cleanly (8/8 tests pass, all 5 actions applied, shipped to remote). 4 high-impact patterns still deferred (A Schema-as-Prompt explicitly highest payoff, F Provider Adapter). Round 2 needed to unlock Pattern A which requires D's profile.md substrate (now in place). Used 1 of 3 max_rounds; not terminating early.

Round 2 shipped cleanly: 29/30 tests pass (1 skipped by intent), Δ=+14.5 ≫ +3 threshold, all 6 action items applied, no regressions vs v5.0 surfaces (validate_rules, score_consistency demo, fill_docx stub mode all bit-for-bit identical). Patterns A2 (partial) + F2 (full) finally unlocked. Remaining defects (#2 first-match-wins, #3 merged-cell traversal) now feasible to fix in R3 because Pattern A2 substrate is in place. 2 of 3 max_rounds used; R3 will be a cleanup round on defects + Pattern I + real-LLM smoke test, then evaluate termination.
